Senses.Explanation: One half of a paired road saying: the records warn that even the road called living contains countless dead people, while the dead road can provide a place for a living person to emerge. Guxue Zhenzhe supplies the warning after unavailable claims deployment through direct warning after an all-unavailable claim. Jie'an Jin supplies the death-case release deployment through direct release after raising Daowu's death exchange. Juelang Daosheng supplies the two-road reworking deployment through direct reworking that distinguishes who can travel each road. Qizhen Cheng supplies the funeral-address application deployment through direct funeral-address application to the deceased monk.
